Privacy & support

Take the Shift?

A local-first tool for comparing the estimated gross pay from an extra shift with the resulting work streak.

Effective date: September 29, 2026

The short version

The current version does not collect, transmit, sell, or share your personal data. It has no account, advertising, analytics, tracking, employer connection, or payroll connection.

Information you enter

You may enter a base hourly rate, multiplier, shift differential, bonus, hours, and current work streak. You may also save a Take or Pass decision.

  • This information remains on your device.
  • It is used only to calculate the estimate and show your local history.
  • The app does not request your name, email address, employer, precise location, contacts, photos, health information, or advertising identifier.

Sharing

If you choose “Share this tradeoff,” the app opens your device’s standard share sheet with text describing the estimate. Nothing is sent unless you select a recipient or another service. Any service you select handles that information under its own privacy policy.

Storage, retention, and deletion

Your pay setup and decision history are stored locally on your device. Android cloud backup is disabled for this app. You can delete the saved pay setup and history from the app’s Pay setup screen. Uninstalling the app also removes its local data.

Children

The app is intended for adults aged 18 and over and is not directed to children.

Important calculation boundary

The app provides a planning estimate based only on values you enter. It does not determine taxes, legal overtime eligibility, benefits, deductions, payroll accuracy, or fatigue safety, and it is not financial, legal, medical, or employment advice. Your employer’s rules and actual payslip control.

Policy changes

If a future version adds analytics, accounts, payments, or any off-device data processing, this policy and the app-store disclosure will be updated before that version is released.

Support and privacy contact

For help, a calculation discrepancy, or a privacy question, email agent@unktokagent.com. Please include the app version and steps to reproduce the issue, but do not send employer-confidential or sensitive personal information.

Operator: Unktok Inc., Japan.

Take the Shift? is an early-stage product. This page remains available for support and privacy questions while the app is distributed.
